category_edits.rationale: Increase pointwise supervision from 0.2 to 0.4 across all four category models to test stronger score anchoring alongside pairwise ranking. Preserve uniform nonpadding-target averaging, GRU architecture, sampling, optimizer, training settings and inference. Enforce the required host data-directory lookup.

change_summary: Increase the pointwise loss coefficient to 0.4 for all four category models and require GAGC_DATA_DIR. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged.
